channels.name: Public
channels.purpose: Open chat with anyone on MeshCore in range. Built in to every device.

channels.name: #missoula
channels.purpose: Local chat for the Missoula Valley. Say hi, ask questions, share news.

channels.name: #testing
channels.purpose: Test messages and range checks. Send your pings here, not on #missoula.

channels.name: #emergency
channels.purpose: Real emergencies only. Keep it clear for people who need help. Call 911 first if you can.

fccNote: MeshCore GitHub issue #945 asks whether the US 62.5 kHz preset meets FCC rule 15.247. There is no FCC action yet. If the preset changes, this page changes with it.
